BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription:
Bite-wing X-rays - twice per year (up to 8 per instance)
All other covered X-rays - one every 5 years

Fillings (amalgam&composite)-1 per tooth per 24 month; Crowns (inlays and onlays)-1 per tooth every 5 years; Crown repairs and recementing of crowns-1 per 36 months but not within 5 years of placement

Root canal - 1 per tooth per lifetime
Root canal retreatment - 1 per tooth per lifetime
Complete or Partial Dentures - 1 every 5 years; Denture repairs, reline&rebase-1 per 24 months,only after 24 months from date of placement
Simple extractions only - 1 per tooth per lifetime
